title: Legal Capacity, Accessibility, and the UN CRPD Framework

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Following the UN CRPD, the Hungarian Civil Code introduced *támogatott döntéshozatal* (supported decision-making) as a less restrictive alternative to guardianship (*gondnokság*), with the aim of preserving the legal capacity (*cselekvőképesség*) of persons with disabilities.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: The CRPD recognises the right to live in the community; in Hungary the *kitagolás* programme (deinstitutionalization) moves residents from large institutions to community-based supported housing (*támogatott lakhatás*).
